messages:
Aisha: Dawn handoff — quick summary before I sign off. We had a burst of TLS handshake failures for Redwood Private EU-W (eu-west) starting ~01:05 UTC after the automated cert rotation. Several customers paged (4 P1s total) but user impact was limited because routing fallback kicked in.

oncall-bot: [01:06 UTC] Pager: 4 incidents opened: RP-3132 (private-euw-tls), RP-3133 (client-retry-bulk), RP-3134 (region-routing-fallback), RP-3135 (legacy-onprem-proxy).

Aisha: What I did so far:
- Scoped scope: failures all had TLS handshake alert (err: TLSv1.2: handshake failed) on edge nodes in eu-west1.
- Rolled certs back on 3/5 infra proxies using `kubectl -n infra rollout undo deploy/proxy-cert-rot` (confirmed pods healthy).
- Flipped routing to prefer dedicated-hosted fallback for affected customers (route set: `route:eu-west -> prefer:hosted-fallback`) which restored traffic for ~85% of requests.
- Opened support threads for the 4 customers and notified CS.

Ben: Nice. Any root cause yet?

Aisha: Early signal points to a malformed cert bundle pushed by the cert automation job (notes at /ops/rotations/last-run). The rotation job didn't include intermediate CA for our legacy proxy images which don't trust the new chain. Newer sidecars are fine.

Leo: Are there any customers still seeing errors?

Aisha: Two customers (AcmePay, HealthSync) still on legacy proxy path because they pin to older images. They're degraded (increased 5xx and client retries). CS has temporary guidance: update image to `proxy:2.14.1` or enable routing override.

Marta: Can you drop the runbook link here?

Aisha: Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/cert-rotation-fallback (see section "Legacy proxy compatibility"), playbook note: run `kubectl -n infra set image deploy/proxy proxy=proxy:2.14.1` for pinned customers, or set route override via Console -> Routes -> Customer -> Force fallback.

Ben: Any risk to Dedicated or Hosted customers?

Aisha: Hosted customers unaffected. Dedicated clusters with newer stack are fine. Only Private deployments where customer hasn't updated proxy image and where cert chain matters were hit.

oncall-bot: [01:27 UTC] Pager RP-3133 escalated to P1 on-call (Ben).

Ben: Picking this up — I'm primary for next 6 hours. Quick checklist:
- Confirm rollback completed and pods stable (Aisha already did for 3/5).
- Identify remaining nodes with bad certs: `kubectl -n infra get pods -o wide | grep proxy | grep CrashLoop`.
- Coordinate with infra to re-run cert automation with fixed bundle.

Leo: I'll run the pod scan and report back in 10m.

Aisha: ETA for infra fix? I left a ticket with infra (INF-4912) — they said they can push a patched cert bundle in ~45min. After that we'll re-roll properly.

Leo: Scan results: 4 pods still running older proxy in eu-west zone B, 2 in zone C. I can cordon and drain the pods one-by-one and apply image update for pinned customers, then restart.

Marta: I'll keep the customer comms loop open with AcmePay and HealthSync, telling them the rollback helped but we have a full fix in progress and ETA ~02:00 UTC.

Ben: Good. Immediate next steps (my action items):
- 01:35 UTC: coordinate with infra to hold further automated rotations until patch applied.
- 01:40 UTC: apply `kubectl -n infra set image` to pinned nodes for AcmePay path (Leo + Ben).
- 01:50 UTC: run smoke test: `curl -v https://private-euw.acmepay/api/health` (expect 200, TLS handshake success).
- 02:05 UTC: validate metrics: TLS handshake failure rate back to baseline, p95 latency normal.

Aisha: I'll drop links to monitoring dashboards and the specific alert definitions:
- Grafana: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/TLS/handshake-failures?orgId=1&var-region=euw
- Alert: `tls_handshake_failure_rate > 0.5% for 2m` -> trigger -> pager.

Leo: Starting upgrades now on eu-west zone B (cordon -> drain -> set image -> uncordon). I'll tag you on each pod restart.

oncall-bot: [01:46 UTC] Update: RP-3132 auto-closed (rollout undo succeeded), RP-3134 routing fallback active.

Aisha: Note for whoever takes over:
- Primary: Ben (01:27–07:27 UTC). Secondary: Leo (shadow).
- Coverage gap: APAC window in ~6h where eu-west maintenance could overlap with APAC jobs — avoid scheduling cert re-rolls during that window.
- Follow-ups: INF-4912 (infra fix), CS-7842 (customer comms), PM ticket to add canary step for legacy proxies.

Marta: I'll collect the customer impact timeline and drop an abbreviated note to #customer-success in 1hr.

Ben: Thanks Aisha — I'll own until 07:27 UTC. If anything escalates, @oncall-bot please page Ben and Leo.

Aisha: Signing off now. All links + runbooks in thread. :thumbsup:

Leo: tagging final pod ids that were restarted: `proxy-euw-b-7f8d`, `proxy-euw-b-7f9a`, `proxy-euw-c-6a2b`. All passed smoke tests.

oncall-bot: [02:02 UTC] RP-3133 resolved (client retries normalized).

Ben: I'll file a short incident summary and candidate postmortem after stabilization. Key takeaway: add intermediate CA validation to rotation job and add a legacy-proxy canary in cert rollout.

Marta: Copy — prepping CS note. Leaving a reminder to schedule postmortem sync at 10:00 UTC with infra + platform + CS.

Ben: Good handoff — leaving on-call log entry now.
